mechanism_narrative: A strong increase in GDP growth rate indicates a robust economy, leading to higher consumer spending and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 50% of instances with strong GDP growth, or the correlation between GDP growth and S&P 500 returns is not significant (p > 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the federal funds rate above 4.5% signals a tightening monetary cycle, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances with high federal funds rates, or the correlation between federal funds rates and S&P 500 returns is not significant (p > 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: A low unemployment rate indicates a strong labor market, leading to higher consumer spending and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 50% of instances with low unemployment rates, or the correlation between unemployment rates and S&P 500 returns is not significant (p > 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts and a decrease in unemployment rate indicate a strong economy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 50% of instances with strong housing starts and low unemployment rates, or the correlation between housing starts and S&P 500 returns is not significant (p > 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production indicates a weakening economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances with low industrial production, or the correlation between industrial production and S&P 500 returns is not significant (p > 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the federal funds rate and an increase in GDP growth rate indicate a strong economy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 50% of instances with high federal funds rates and strong GDP growth, or the correlation between federal funds rates and S&P 500 returns is not significant (p > 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: A high unemployment rate and a decrease in consumer spending indicate a weakening economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances with high unemployment rates and low consumer spending, or the correlation between unemployment rates and S&P 500 returns is not significant (p > 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts and a rise in consumer spending indicate a strong economy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in > 50% of instances with strong housing starts and high consumer spending, or the correlation between housing starts and S&P 500 returns is not significant (p > 0.1).
